verdict.rationale: Bruno explicitly rejects a cloud-synced workspace model ("No cloud sync. No account.") and instead enables team sharing via Git: collections stored as plain text files that teams commit/pull/clone through Bruno's built-in Git UI, plus README buttons to open shared workspaces. This delivers team collaboration on collections but not a real-time "synced shared workspace" — it's file/version-control based, requiring git setup and lacking live sync. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time multi-user sync, a hosted/cloud shared workspace feature, or conflict resolution for simultaneous edits.
